Learning model

Programs

Courses to spot opportunities, organize systems and convert better.

Each course covers a key growth area with practical examples, decision criteria and actions that apply to real companies.

01

Digital Diagnosis for CEOs

Helps detect missed opportunities in your website, social channels, communication and digital sales process.

Online course · 20 h · Certificate

  • Website, social channels and value proposition
  • Conversion, trust and leakage points
  • Quick wins and improvement priorities

For owners, CEOs and leaders who want to understand what to improve first.

 02

Websites that convert

Learn how to structure a website designed to build trust, explain your offer and turn visits into inquiries.

Online course · 29 h · Certificate

  • Hero, value proposition and CTAs
  • Structure, trust and user journey
  • Landing pages and result-oriented websites

For brands, businesses and professionals who want a more effective website.

 03

Professional brand

Learn how to organize your brand image, message and communication to transmit more clarity and trust.

Online course · 40 h · Certificate

  • Positioning, message and value proposition
  • Tone, identity and visual consistency
  • Website, social channels and sales materials

For brands that feel messy or do not communicate their real value.

 04

Digital Marketing from Zero

A practical introduction to understand digital channels and start building a simple plan for your business.

Online course · 100 h · Certificate

  • Fundamentals, channels and basic metrics
  • Content, funnels and online presence
  • Initial 30-day marketing plan

For entrepreneurs and people who want to start without getting overwhelmed.

 05

Digital Sales for Entrepreneurs

Learn how to answer inquiries, present your offer and follow up to turn more interested people into customers.

Online course · 25 h · Certificate

  • WhatsApp, Instagram and sales messages
  • Objections, follow-up and closing
  • Scripts and simple sales flow

For businesses that receive inquiries but convert too few.

 06

AI Content Creation

Use AI tools to generate ideas, copy and content pieces in a faster and more organized way.

Online course · 14 h · Certificate

  • Ideas, prompts and content calendar
  • Posts, captions and sales content
  • AI applied without hype or complexity

For brands that do not know what to post or want to create content faster.
Why learn with us

We are an agency that also trains. That changes everything.

We do not teach from a classroom. We teach from active projects. What enters the program is what we have already proven works.

01

Real cases, not textbook scenarios

Examples and exercises come from projects we run at the agency, not invented situations built just to make sense in class.

02

Mentors who execute today

The people teaching have active projects in agencies and companies. They bring what works now, not what worked five years ago.

03

Deliverables, not notes

Each module closes with something concrete: an applied template, a documented process, a configured system. Not a PDF to store and forget.

04

Feedback on what you did

Deliverables are reviewed. You receive specific judgment on your work, not generic comments that could apply to anyone.

Method

Learn by doing, with deliverables that keep working.

The academy is not built as a video library. It is built as a progress system: context, practice, feedback and application.

01

Diagnosis

We identify the starting point, goals and real gaps of the business or team.

02

Framework

We use simple models to organize decisions, not isolated theory.

03

Implementation

Each module ends with an asset, process or dashboard applied to a concrete case.

04

Feedback

We review deliverables to improve judgment, clarity and execution quality.
